[b][size=6]Infinite Energy:[/size][/b]
[size=5]
Description[/size]
[size=4]This mod maintains the player's health at maximum capacity. It is designed to be a lightweight solution for removing combat and environmental damage constraints from the gameplay.[/size]


[list]
[*][size=4][b]Energy Persistence:[/b] Prevents energy depletion regardless of the activity or tool used.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Exhaustion Prevention:[/b] Disables the exhaustion state and its associated movement penalties.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Configurable:[/b] Settings can be toggled or adjusted via the Generic Mod Config Menu.[/size][/*]
[/list][b][size=5]Requirements[/size][/b]

[list]
[*][size=4][b]SMAPI[/b] - Stardew Modding API[/size][/*]
[*][b][size=4]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/size][/b][/*]
[/list][b][size=5]Installation[/size][/b]

[list=1]
[*][size=4]Ensure both [b]SMAPI[/b] and [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] are installed.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Download this mod and extract the folder.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Place the folder into your[/size]


[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code][size=4]directory.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Run the game through SMAPI.[/size][/*]
[/list][b][size=5]Technical Details[/size][/b]

[list]
[*][size=4][b]Compatibility:[/b] Stardew Valley 1.6+.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Save Safety:[/b] Can be installed or uninstalled on existing save files without issues.[/size][/*]
[/list][b][size=5]Credits[/size][/b]

[size=4]Developed by [b]GalaxilliPipo[/b]. Technical issues and bug reports should be submitted via the "Bugs" or "Posts" section.[/size]
